findings.reason: a worker obeying §16 must either edit a §14 test file it has no write scope for, or ship a head arm with added failures in a landed file, and neither satisfies the plan as written.
findings.text: §16's done-when requires "It finds store_committed_review refused the same way", but §14's landed test test_a_promoted_claimless_record_is_committed_and_still_reported (tests/test_a_claimless_finding_is_not_a_finding.py:211) drives a claimless record through crew.complete promotion and asserts the committed file exists and holds [PLACEHOLDER] at lines 273-274, and tests (1) and (2) in the same file store a claimless record through store_review via _store (line 57); all six tests pass at base (6 passed), so §16's new refusals red them, which contradicts the done-when's clause "give the same pass and fail ids at head as at base, apart from the new file"

findings.reason: the three sites are enumerated explicitly and govern the implementation, so a worker builds all three; the framing sentence is imprecise but not load-bearing.
findings.text: the Deliverable asserts the claimless refusal is applied "wherever a record's status is already validated", but store_committed_review performs no status validation (it checks project, review run id, subject and review material only — review.py:2636-2660), so the sentence describes two sites where the plan then lists three, misstating the code the mechanism rests on
